# ADR-3265: AWS backups: AWS Backup plan required key for workload 1

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Missing backups turn incidents into data loss.

## Decision

Workloads SHALL declare an AWS Backup plan required key for workload 1 (AWS-backups-1).

## Consequences

Plans define frequency and cold storage.
